proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.targeted_by_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing reaction trigger surface can target named spells or post-save spell outcomes, but not an arbitrary spell that targets only the reactor and has no area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and doesn't create an area of effect

proposed_widenings.name: magic-item absorbed spell-energy reservoir resource
proposed_widenings.justification: The rod stores spell levels from canceled spells, has a current stored amount, a lifetime absorption ceiling of 50, and an initial stored amount when found. Existing charge_pool semantics do not cover this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The rod can absorb and store up to 50 levels of energy over the course of its existence.

proposed_widenings.name: wielder spell-slot substitution using stored item energy
proposed_widenings.justification: The rod does not grant named spells; it lets the wielder spend stored energy in place of their own spell slots when casting spells they already know or have prepared.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can convert energy stored in it into spell slots to cast spells you have prepared or know

proposed_widenings.name: conditional nonmagical lifecycle after reservoir exhaustion
proposed_widenings.justification: The rod becomes nonmagical only after it has reached its lifetime absorption limit and then has no stored energy remaining. Existing permanent_on_empty is too broad.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A rod that can no longer absorb spell energy and has no energy remaining becomes nonmagical.

notes: No content file was authored. The item fits the existing magic_item/composite family structurally, but it needs missing trigger and resource variants to encode honestly.
